description: This file defines abstractions and classes for transforming logical tensor arguments into physical representations in the context of vmap operations in PyTorch, including VmapPhysicalView, VmapTransform, and related utilities.

classes.name: VmapPhysicalView
classes.description: Represents a physical view of a tensor with batch dimensions at the front, including methods for mapping logical to physical dimensions and shapes.

classes.name: VmapPhysicalToLogicalMap
classes.description: Facilitates mapping a physical tensor back to a logical (batched) tensor, assuming batch dimensions are at the front.

classes.name: MultiBatchVmapTransform
classes.description: Provides static methods to convert logical tensor views with multiple batch dims into physical views.

classes.name: BroadcastingVmapTransform
classes.description: Provides static methods to broadcast multiple logical tensor views into compatible physical views.

methods.name: logicalToPhysical
methods.description: Converts logical tensor(s) to physical view(s) by permuting batch dims and aligning shapes.

methods.name: getPhysicalDims
methods.description: Maps logical dimension indices to physical dimension indices, considering batch dims.

methods.name: getPhysicalDim
methods.description: Maps a single logical dimension to its physical dimension index.

methods.name: getPhysicalShape
methods.description: Converts a logical shape to a physical shape by prepending batch sizes.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Maps a physical tensor to a logical tensor, assuming batch dims are at the front.

methods.name: applyInplace
methods.description: Maps a list of physical tensors to logical tensors in-place.
